title: Creamy Butter Garlic Mushrooms
equip: 1 stainless steel skillet or small deep nonstick pan, 1 small bowl

items.n: Emborg Perfect Pasta cream (replaces Amul fresh cream + milk)

steps.x: Heat the mustard oil in the pan on medium until it just starts to smoke lightly. Add the onion and fry 6 min, stirring, until soft and light golden. Scoop onions into a bowl and set aside.
In the same pan, add the butter and 1 tsp oil on medium-low. Add the garlic and cook 1 min until fragrant and pale golden. Don't let it brown.
Turn the heat to medium-high and add the mushrooms. Cook 6 min, stirring now and then, until the water evaporates and they are lightly browned.
Pour in 100 ml of the Emborg and stir 2 min until it coats the mushrooms.
Sprinkle in the wheat flour and stir 1 min so the raw flour taste cooks off. Return the fried onions to the pan.
Add the Kashmiri chilli, pepper, salt and garam masala. Stir 30 sec.
Pour in the remaining 150 ml Emborg. Simmer on medium-low for 5-7 min, stirring, until thick and the colour turns orange-pink. If it gets too thick, loosen with 2 tbsp water.
Stir in the coriander and serve hot with roti, garlic bread or rice.

notes: The video doesn't show amounts for garlic, mushrooms, cream or salt. These are estimates, so adjust the salt at the end.
Emborg is lighter than Amul fresh cream, so the sauce is a bit thinner. The flour step covers this, so don't skip it.
Improvement: salt the mushrooms only after they brown (step 6). Early salt makes them release water and steam instead of sear.
Improvement: don't crowd the pan. If you double the recipe, sear the mushrooms in two batches.
Improvement: finish with a squeeze of lemon (1 tsp) off the heat to cut the richness.
Spicy for a child. Plate the child's portion before adding the Kashmiri chilli and pepper (step 6).
Storage: 2 days in the fridge. Reheat gently on the stove with a splash of milk or water. Not great frozen, because the cream splits.
Leftover Emborg: use it in the pasta sauce or stir it into dal.
